policy: Stable test IDs are never reused; changes to an expectation increment its revision; run results append to the event log rather than replacing prior observations.
combination_policy: One native patient restore, seven coexisting plans, three studysets; initial checks combined by plan. Coupled settings require recording all affected controls; use a focused follow-up only when attribution is ambiguous.

profiles.purpose: Plan association and baseline settings; source beam aperture records retained.
Compare distinct MC fields in flag-0 mode, 2 mm grid, water deposition and forced ED 1.1 in one plan.
Compare distinct MC fields in flag-1 mode, 3 mm grid, medium deposition and force-water in one plan.
8x6 cm candidate header aperture plus plan fill ED 0.8; force-water stays off.
Eight central second-bank leaf tips at +10 mm plus disabled Insert plan override.
Plan Insert ED 1.1 against studyset ED 1.2; compare with Density-Aligned.
Both Insert density representations at 1.2, using the same beam/settings as Density-Conflict.
